description: Follow-up Social photo upgrades: two Manchester city covers plus one cleaned stock photograph shared by the hybrid space and challenge.

sources.subject: Athlete working battle ropes
sources.processing: Minimal logo removal with the built-in image editor, landscape crop, resize and WebP compression. The cleaned photograph is shared by the hybrid challenge and Hybrid Training space.

retouch.model: Not exposed by the built-in tool
retouch.scope: Remove the vest swoosh and small footwear emblems.
retouch.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing photograph used as a fitness app's hybrid challenge cover.
Input image: edit target, the provided real photograph of an athlete working battle ropes under a concrete walkway.
Primary request: remove the small white Nike swoosh on the athlete's black vest, blending only that mark into the surrounding black fabric. Also remove any small brand emblems on the shoes if visible, preserving the actual shoe shape, seams and material.
Constraints: make only these very small logo removals. Preserve the athlete's exact identity, face, body, skin texture, pose, vest, shorts and footwear; preserve every rope, the concrete architecture, railings, lighting, colors, shadows, camera perspective and original landscape framing. Keep the photograph natural and otherwise unchanged. No added text, graphics, logos, watermark, or new objects.
